messages:
deploy-bot: Tag v2.14.0 created from main at commit abc123ef (author: @ben). Release artifacts uploaded.
Changelog (short):
- feature: smarter KV cache eviction for long-running chats
- perf: attention kernel improvements (~12% token throughput)
- fix: batching edge case that caused token duplication
- infra: pin model rdlm-v1.2-quant for inference groups

Environments: staging -> canary(5%) -> gradual prod rollout
Canary window: 30m. Rollback target: v2.13.9
Release notes link: https://go.redwood/release/2.14.0

celeste: Ack. Can we add a note about the model pin? customers on private deploys need heads up.

ben (release): Canary start target 13:00 UTC. I'll request pin in docs and update the release page. @maya please run smoke suite once canary is up.

maya (qa): Will do. Smoke checklist: 1) basic generate endpoint, 2) embeddings sanity, 3) latency p95 check. I’ll post results in-thread.

sre-oncall: Setting auto-rollback policy: error rate > 2% OR p95 latency > 800ms triggers immediate rollback. I'll watch infra metrics and traces. If we need to rollback, use:
```
redwood deploy --tag v2.13.9 --env prod --reason "auto-rollback"
# or
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rd-inference -n prod --to-revision=<previous>
```

ben (release): Note: we pinned the model in serving config to `rdlm-v1.2-quant`. Keep routing fallback to `rdlm-v1.1` for 60s after deploy.

celeste: Adding migration note to release notes and emailing partners list.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 13:02 UTC — 5% traffic routed to v2.14.0 canary (instantiated on pool-gpu-a).

maya (qa): Smoke run: generate ok, embeddings ok, no duplication observed. Latency p95 ~ 320ms. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Observability: error 0.09% over last 10m, CPU & GPU utilization steady. No KV cache OOMs.

ben (release): Proceeding to 25% at 13:35 if no regressions. Will post update. Pin request: can someone pin the deploy-bot message and the release page link? :shipit:

celeste: Pinned and added a short blurb in docs.

deploy-bot: Gradual rollout: 25% -> 60% -> 100% scheduled with 15m windows between steps. Will announce each step.

maya (qa): If anything flares up during 25%, mark as high and call the oncall.

sre-oncall: Copy. Ready to execute rollback if thresholds crossed. Monitoring alert set in PagerDuty.

ben (release): Final note: keep an eye on embedding QoE for next 24h. If any quality regression, revert model pin and roll back to v2.13.9. Notify #incidents and execs.

deploy-bot: Canary completed 13:32 UTC. Moving to 25% now.

maya (qa): 25% smoke green. No regressions observed so far.

sre-oncall: Metrics look healthy at 25%. p95 340ms, errors 0.12%.

ben (release): Rolling to 60% in 10m. Thanks team — will update when prod is at 100%.

(THREAD NOTE: pinned by celeste)
